versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud OSS ossfs & container mount diagnosis skill.

- Diagnoses ossfs and container OSS mount issues (mount failures, disappeared mountpoints, storage volume 403 errors, archive read 403).
- Provides read-only analysis: attributes causes such as credential file, endpoint/region mismatch, RAM permissions, and FUSE dependency.
- Enforces absolute prohibition on executing or suggesting any mutating commands (mount, fusermount, bucket config changes, credential handling).
- All cloud-side checks are performed only by included scripts; never re-implements queries or handles credentials directly.
- Answers only within strict scope; routes out-of-scope questions to sibling skills as documented.
- Official doc verification and citation strictly based on script outputs; never fabricates references.
- Diagnostic output always provides a final user-facing report, even in degraded/error situations.
